topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture theme on cancer evolution and outlines the core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications drive clonal expansion and Darwinian selection in pre-malignant tissues.

topics.label: Cell of origin and stem cell models in tumor initiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how normal tissue hierarchies and stemness properties dictate which cell types can initiate and propagate tumors.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how external promoters, chronic inflammation, and stromal cells in the microenvironment support tumor initiation and maintenance.

topics.label: Methods for investigating tumor heterogeneity and spatial biology
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, and computational techniques used to study tumor evolution and cell interactions.

topics.label: Synthesis of multi-factorial cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates mutations, cell state, inflammation, and microenvironmental factors into a unified model of cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture closing and next steps
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
